metadata.description: Shared Claude Code plugins for gocougs2020 repositories: the pre-push check, and general web design and accessibility practices.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Check a branch before every push: merge the default branch, catch overlap with other open pull requests, run the checks, review for bugs and security, and fix. A hook blocks Claude's git push until that commit was checked.

plugins.name: web-design
plugins.description: General web design, accessibility, and React/Next.js performance practices from Vercel, applied when building or reviewing UI.
